hero.title: 10 Best Stargazing Spots in NamibRand
hero.dek: The Reddit-approved guide to Africa's darkest skies. NamibRand Nature Reserve is a Gold Tier International Dark Sky Reserve — one of the best places on Earth to see the Milky Way with the naked eye.

intro.answerFirst: Ranging from budget-friendly campsites to ultra-luxurious lodges, NamibRand offers stargazing experiences for every traveler, but for a truly immersive experience, Tok-Tokkie Trails stands out, offering guided walking trails where you sleep under the stars. As Africa's first Gold Tier International Dark Sky Reserve, NamibRand Nature Reserve, located about 550 km southwest of Windhoek in the heart of the Namib Desert, boasts some of the darkest and clearest night skies on Earth.
body: NamibRand Nature Reserve sits in the heart of the Namib Desert, about 550 km southwest of Windhoek. Designated as Africa's first — and the world's second — Gold Tier International Dark Sky Reserve , it offers some of the darkest, clearest night skies anywhere on Earth.

With minimal light pollution and almost no atmospheric moisture, you can see thousands of individual stars, the Milky Way stretching horizon to horizon, both Magellanic Clouds, and the zodiacal light — all with the naked eye.

faq.question: Why is NamibRand one of the best stargazing destinations on Earth?
faq.answer: NamibRand is a Gold Tier International Dark Sky Reserve with virtually zero light pollution.

faq.question: When is the best time for stargazing in NamibRand?
faq.answer: April to October offers the clearest skies. The Milky Way core is best May to September.

faq.question: How do I get to NamibRand?
faq.answer: Most visitors fly from Windhoek via charter planes (about 70 minutes). The drive is 5+ hours.

faq.question: Do I need a telescope?
faq.answer: No. The skies are so dark that naked-eye stargazing is extraordinary.
